entry.title: 30 Rockefeller Plaza
entry.note: Exact signed full ground and individual slab parts retain native+X toward eastern Rockefeller Plaza, +Z toward49th Street and -Z toward50th Street. West low block is toward Sixth Avenue. Main three portals face east; lowered Skylift sits on west70F and Beam on north69F. GroundY0 is the entry datum; adjacent rink/plaza and other Rockefeller Center buildings are excluded. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
